# OpenEndo

> Open data hub for endometriosis research — clinical trials, papers, funding & policy, refreshed weekly from ClinicalTrials.gov and PubMed. Open source, MIT, built for patients, researchers and policymakers.
>
> **Deployment note:** the public UI (openendo.org) is a Lovable app — repo files are NOT served there. All links below are raw.githubusercontent URLs (the only working public paths for repo content).

RAW = https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main

## Agents: start here
- [CHECKPOINT.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/CHECKPOINT.md): living task board — current focus, horizon tasks, blockers, change log (READ FIRST)
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/AGENTS.md): repo rules for agents

## Reference pages (static implementation — rendered by the Lovable app in its own design)
- [Dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/index.html): live analytics — recruiting trials worldwide/by country, Denmark status, PubMed output, target intelligence, funding watch
- [Knowledge base hub (human)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/wiki.html): rendered wiki index
- [Style guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/styleguide.html): design system, brand, voice
- [How to support](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/support.html): seven ways to contribute
- [AI & compute agenda](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/ai-agenda.html): how AI/agents/compute can move endometriosis research
- [One-pager for decision-makers (EN)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/one-pager-en.html)
- [**What we know / what we don't — research explainer (visual)**](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/what-we-know.html): plain-language tour — targets, repurposing, virtual testing, honest gaps
- [One-pager for decision-makers (DA)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/one-pager-dk.html)

## Machine-readable data (JSON)

- [Repurposing candidates (9 approved-drug pairs)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/data/repurposing_candidates.json)
- [Funding opportunities with deadlines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/data/funding.json)
- [Access finder — country/postcode → meds, centres, help](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/data/access.json) — DK full, GB/US/DE orgs (schema openendo-access-v1)
- [Editorial content (EN/DA)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/data/content.json)

- [RO-Crate manifest (FAIR packaging of all datasets)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/data/ro-crate-metadata.jsonld)

## Knowledge base
> Knowledge pages are raw markdown (human hub: wiki.html reference page). SCHEMA first.
- [SCHEMA](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/SCHEMA.md): conventions for creating/editing knowledge pages (agents must read)
- [Entities — ryeqo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/entities/ryeqo.md): relugolix combo, EU-approved, generelt tilskud in DK
- [Entities — yselty](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/entities/yselty.md): linzagolix, EU-approved Dec 2024, no general reimbursement for endometriosis in DK (verified 2026-09-02)
- [Entities — hmi-115](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/entities/hmi-115.md): first non-hormonal therapy in Phase 3
- [Entities — my-endo-trial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/entities/my-endo-trial.md): NCT06211231 — digital mindfulness/acceptance self-management, recruiting in Denmark
- [Entities — sirolimus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/entities/sirolimus.md): mTOR inhibitor, M3 repurposing rank 1 — mTOR/ovarian-senescence evidence; GEO reanalysis confirms FKBP4 2.2x down in lesions; no registered endo trial
- [Concepts — gnrh-antagonists](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/concepts/gnrh-antagonists.md): the class behind Ryeqo/Yselty
- [Concepts — saliva-diagnostics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/concepts/saliva-diagnostics.md): non-invasive testing vs diagnostic delay
- [Concepts — ferroptosis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/concepts/ferroptosis.md): iron-dependent cell death — SEMA3C paper, GPX4/SLC7A11 targets, sulfasalazine convergence
- [Concepts — computational-drug-repurposing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/concepts/computational-drug-repurposing.md): simvastatin/primaquine POC + M3 ChEMBL screen (9 pairs)
- [Concepts — mrgprx2-pain](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/concepts/mrgprx2-pain.md): mast-cell MRGPRX2/histamine/TRPV1 pain axis — cetrorelix hit is target-validating; GEO reanalysis confirms mast-cell markers 11-15x enriched in lesions
- [Concepts — diversity-gap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/concepts/diversity-gap.md): under-representation of racial/ethnic minorities in endo research + trials; access bias, not biology (5 PMIDs, 2017-2025)
- [Concepts — danish-registries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/concepts/danish-registries.md): DNPR/Rx/MBR/psychiatric registers; CPR-linkage; diagnostic delay, obstetric outcomes, mental health burden; registry analytics entry point (7 PMIDs, 2017-2026)
- [Comparisons — ryeqo vs yselty](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/knowledge/comparisons/ryeqo-vs-yselty.md)

## Research (Percival's workstream, merged)
- [M1 fold-input pack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/research/structures/fold_input/README.md): 35 novel drug targets, AlphaFold-ready
- [Virtual testing pipeline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/research/virtual-testing.md): structure/docking/MD validation ladder + infra + phases
- [Phase 0 audit — structure & expression coverage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/research/virtual/phase0.md): AFDB 27/35, PDB structures for all M3 targets, HPA, ChEMBL (+ [machine data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/research/virtual/phase0.json))
- [Phase 0.5 — lesion expression reanalysis (GEO)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/research/virtual/phase0.5.md): GSE282532 done — FKBP4 2.2x down, mast-cell markers 11-15x up, SLC7A11 2x down in ectopic lesions; GSE247695/263897 remain open
- [M2 living evidence — digest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/research/evidence/digest-2026-09-02.md): weekly evidence synthesis (PubMed + Europe PMC)
- [M2 evidence weekly data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/research/evidence/weekly/2026-09-02.json): machine-readable evidence snapshot
- [M3 repurposing screen digest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/research/evidence/digest-2026-09-02.md): 9 drug-repurposing candidates (see digest)
- [T7 lab software modernization track](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/research/lab-software-modernization.md): Danish lab software roadmap
- [Integration contract — RO-Crate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/research/tools-and-integration.md): how the hub plugs into ELN/LIMS/repositories
